channel.title: Verkada incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Verkada's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Command is experiencing degraded performance for some customers [resolved]
Some Viewing Stations are offline [resolved]
item.description:
We identified an issue affecting Viewing Stations with a non-English locale set. We’ve since shipped a new version, that resolves it.
Symptom: affected customers most likely saw a black screen on their VX.
What we’ve done: went through the list of affected devices, manually updated the ones we could, and verified they’re back to a healthy, streaming state.

item.title: Service disruption for Security Screening feature [resolved]
Verkada Command not loading [resolved]
item.description: Command login remains stable after resolving an infrastructure issue causing difficulty logging in.

item.title: Issues with Managing Command Users and Access Controllers are appearing offline in GovCloud [resolved]
Multiple Command services are degraded or unavailable [resolved]
item.description: All services have been restored and are operating normally and the underlying issue has been resolved. Please reach out to our Support team if you are experience any further issues.

item.title: Users unable to add Mobile NFC credentials to Apple Wallet [resolved]
item.description: Engineering resolved the issue and users should be able to claim Mobile NFC credentials as normal.
